tools.description: Search local business profiles on Bezal by name, category, or location. Every business includes name, category, city, state, rating, review count, tier and quote_request_url (its public Bezal profile, where a person can send a request). Phone, website, address, hours, photos and coordinates are included only for providers on a paid Bezal plan, and the description only on Business and Premium.

query.description: Free-text search across business name and description

state.description: Two-letter state code or full state name

tools.name: search_businesses

tools.description: Get the public Bezal profile for one business by UUID. Every business includes name, category, city, state, rating, review count, tier and quote_request_url (its public Bezal profile, where a person can send a request). Phone, website, address, hours, photos and coordinates are included only for providers on a paid Bezal plan, and the description only on Business and Premium. For services, use get_service_catalog.

id.description: The UUID of the business to look up

tools.name: get_business

tools.description: List all available business categories in the directory.
tools.name: list_categories

tools.description: Send a service request to a business on behalf of a person. Returns delivered: true only when the business owner was notified. Businesses that haven't claimed their Bezal profile get the request saved but aren't notified.

business_id.description: The UUID of the business to send the request to

message.description: Detailed message about what the requester needs

seeker_name.description: Name of the person requesting the service

service_needed.description: Short description of the service category

tools.name: request_service

tools.description: Find businesses that list a specific service, when you know the exact service rather than the category (for example "Drain cleaning" rather than "plumbing"). Every business includes name, category, city, state, rating, review count, tier and quote_request_url (its public Bezal profile, where a person can send a request). Phone, website, address, hours, photos and coordinates are included only for providers on a paid Bezal plan, and the description only on Business and Premium.

location.description: Optional city or state to filter by

service_type.description: Exact service offered (matched against the services list)

tools.name: search_by_service

tools.description: Get reviews for a specific business: Bezal reviews (rating, text, verified flag, date and the reviewer as first name and last initial) plus the Google rating and review count.
tools.name: get_reviews

tools.description: Get services and pricing for a specific business. Falls back to the list of service names if no priced catalog exists.
tools.name: get_service_catalog

tools.description: Check whether a business is open on a date, based on its posted opening hours. Hours are shared only for providers on a paid Bezal plan, and other listings come back with open set to "unknown". It doesn't know about bookings, so confirm a time with the business.
tools.name: check_business_availability

tools.description: Compare up to 5 businesses side by side: the public profile fields plus services, BezalRank and whether the profile is claimed. Every business includes name, category, city, state, rating, review count, tier and quote_request_url (its public Bezal profile, where a person can send a request). Phone, website, address, hours, photos and coordinates are included only for providers on a paid Bezal plan, and the description only on Business and Premium.

business_ids.description: Array of business UUIDs to compare
